name: Pass the Trash
description: Pass the Trash is a stud poker variant in which each player receives seven cards, posts antes, and after a betting round passes three unwanted cards to the next active player to the left. After a second betting round players discard two cards, order the remaining five face down, then reveal them one at a time with betting between each reveal. The highest five-card hand at showdown wins the pot.

Country/Region of Origin: USA
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game
2 to 7 players. Best with 4. No partnerships.
Standard 52-card deck. One deck. No jokers.
Standard 52-card deck, poker chips for antes and betting.
After antes are placed, seven cards are dealt face down to each player. Dealing is clockwise.

items.text: High-Low: Before showdown everyone declares high, low, or both (e.g. chips in fist); high and low winners split the pot.
Three-phase pass: First phase: three cards passed left. Second: two cards passed two places left. Third: one card passed three places left. Betting round after each phase.
Pot split with next right: Pot is split between the high hand and the next active player to the right (the one who received your passed cards).
